experience: A focused Quest discussion is asked what the Quest already recorded about its decision; the answer must come from the Quest's current record, not a guess or a message sent to the core.
rule: t3_quest_context: Read the Quest a thread belongs to ... Nothing here sends messages or applies answers.

experience: The owner had to copy one discussion's delivery into another by hand before it could plan the next milestone; the Quest record should carry it instead.
rule: t3_quest_context lists results other discussions recorded; t3_quest_propose_plan records edits citing them; only the owner applies.

pattern: a Quest discussion reads its Quest before working on its subject
experience: Quest membership reached the agent only as an editable composer briefing. With the composer left to the owner, a natural request in a Quest discussion gave the agent no sign it should read the recorded decision first.
rule: Per-turn <t3_quest_membership> orientation from the thread's recorded membership.
